$comment: One-line purpose of every Figma component set. Source for the generated Figma descriptions (ad-design-kit-figma-sync/scripts/build-figma-descriptions.mjs). Edit the summary here, not in Figma.

sets.summary: Alert — persistent, contextual message for a page or section (validation summary, account status, offline).
Accordion — collapsible sections (Default, Flush, Separate cards, Multi-level, With sub-header).
Banner — site-wide, dismissible announcement strip (promo, cookie notice, maintenance, newsletter).
Badge — short status, category or count label (1–2 words).
Download App Button — App Store / Google Play badge link for marketing pages.
Button — triggers an action (submit, open overlay, start a flow).
Bottom navigation item — icon + label destination (Initial, Hover/active).
Bottom navigation — mobile bar for 3–5 top-level destinations (Bordered, Action button, Pagination, Segment controls).
Bottom bar (desktop) — call and media-player control bars.
Button group — joined row of Secondary (Gray) or Tertiary (White) buttons for 2–5 related actions or a compact view switcher.
Button group examples — ready-made compositions (icons, numbers, plus & minus, with dropdown/badge, vertical).
Breadcrumb — location in a hierarchy ≥3 levels deep (Default, Background, dropdown, group buttons, badge).
Breadcrumb item — link with optional icon and separator (Initial, Hover, Active = current page).
Card — groups information about one entity (product, post, profile, plan, KPI); 15 layouts.
Bubble content — text, file, audio, calendar, image grid, link preview.
Bubble — message container. Orientation=Right is used by received messages, Orientation=Left (brand-tinted) by sent messages; Clean = no fill.
Chat bubble — conversational message row with avatar (Text, File, Audio, Calendar, Images, URL × received Left / sent Right).
Carousel — slides of equivalent visual items or testimonials.
Carousel control — previous/next button on imagery (overlay-light fill).
Carousel indicator — slide dot (Initial, Active).
Device mockups — phone, tablet, laptop, desktop, watch frames for product screenshots on marketing pages.
Drawer — side or bottom panel for secondary tasks that keep page context (filters, details, create/edit forms, mobile navigation).
Drawer heading — title row with close button (heading, logo, icon, avatar, user group, breadcrumb).
Drawer footer — action row (two buttons, buttons & links, three buttons, confirm).
Dropdown item — menu row (16 types × Initial/Hover/Disabled).
Dropdown header — user/info block at the top of a menu.
Dropdown menu — list of actions or options revealed from a trigger (16 layouts: profile, separators, radio/checkbox/toggle, users, scroll, grid, language).
Dropdown triggers — Button, Ghost button, icon button, Avatar, Avatar & name, Link.
Input form — Label + Input field + Helper stack (gap 10px).
Select form — choose one value from 5+ known options.
Search form — filter/search content (with search/filters buttons).
Number form — small bounded integers with steppers (quantity, guests).
Phone form — phone number with country dial-code selector.
Copy to clipboard form — read-only value with copy action (API keys, links, codes).
Input field — single-line text control (4 sizes, 7 states).
File upload — Default (single file in a form) or Advanced dropzone.
File upload dropzone — multiple files / media; states Initial, Hover, Disabled, Success, Danger.
Tag input — free-form multiple values as chips (emails, keywords).
OTP input box — one-time code digit (4 sizes, 7 states).
OTP form examples — 4–8 digit code entry with optional separators.
Textarea — multi-line plain text (comments, descriptions); toolbar variants for chat/comments.
Rich text editor — multi-line text with formatting toolbar.

sets.figmaName: Textarea input ready to use examples
sets.summary: Textarea examples — Label + Textarea + Helper compositions.
Label — form field label (required asterisk, info icon, hint).
Helper — helper/validation text under a field (12px).
Floating label input — label floats inside the field (Default/underline, With background/filled, Bordered/outlined).
Datepicker cell — day/month/year cell (Initial, Hover, Active, range start/between/end, Outlined = today, Disabled).
Datepicker controls — month/year header with previous/next buttons.
Datepicker menu — calendar popover (Default, Range, Year, Month, Day/Year/Month pickers).
Datepicker — pick a date or range near "now" (bookings, due dates).
Timepicker input — time field with clock icon (add-on variants, 4 sizes, 7 states).
Timepicker — pick a time of day or a booking slot (single or range).
Timepicker menu — slot list, time input, or slider popovers.
Autocomplete — type to pick from a large or remote list (users, cities, tags).
Autocomplete menu — suggestion listbox (Default, CTA, save option, advanced, categories).
Autocomplete item — suggestion row (Initial, Hover, Disabled).
Range slider — approximate value(s) in a bounded range (price filter, volume).
Range slider helper — min/max labels.
Range slider bar — track + filled range.
Range slider thumb — Initial / Active.
Toggle switch — binary setting that applies immediately (base, lg).
Toggle inputs — toggle with label/helper, icons, card and segmented-control layouts.
Toggle label.
Toggle helper text.
Toggle group — stacked settings list.
Checkbox / Radio input — Checkbox for independent opt-ins and multi-select; Radio for one of 2–5 visible options.
Checkbox / Radio form (choice cards) — options that need description or visuals (plans, payment, shipping). The whole card is the label.
Checkbox / Radio group — stacked or grid groups of choices inside a fieldset with legend.
Checkbox / Radio label.
Checkbox / Radio helper text.
Gallery — browsable image collection (grids, featured, carousel, filters, masonry).
Icon shape — decorative coloured container for an icon (6 sizes × 7 colours × circle/square).
Jumbotron — landing-page hero with one message and ≤2 CTAs (heading + CTA, background image, illustration, form, gradient, navbar, bento).
List item — 11 row types (icons, numbers, badges, images, transactions) × Initial/Hover/Disabled.
List — vertically stacked items with 1–3 attributes (Default, Divider, Card, CTA).
Modal — blocking dialog for decisions or short focused tasks (confirm, sign in, short forms ≤6 fields).
Modal header — title row with close (icon, breadcrumb, avatars, logo, supporting text).
Modal footer — actions row (buttons, buttons & links, three buttons, pagination).
Nav link — navigation link (13 types × Initial/Hover/Active/Disabled).
Navbar — global site/app header (logo, ≤7 links, search, actions); breakpoint variants are responsive layouts.
Navbar content — inner layouts of the navbar row.
Mega menu (full width) — large navigation panel under the navbar.
Mega menu (fixed width) — dropdown navigation panel with icons, categories or CTA.
Mobile menu — navbar links, search and account actions on small screens.
Nav tabs — switch between peer views of the same context (Default, Pills, Button, Button group, Border bottom, Vertical).
Nav item (tab) — single tab (Default, Pill, Border bottom, User select × Initial/Active).
Popover — rich or interactive content anchored to an element (profile card, password rules, inline help).
Popover content — text, profiles, image, progress, password strength, paragraphs, CTA.
Pagination — navigate large ordered datasets (numbers, arrows, rows-per-page, jump-to input).
Progress — determinate progress with label (top, side, bottom) in 6 colours.
Progress bar track (base 6px, lg 10px).
Rating — display aggregate stars or collect a 1–5 rating (radio input).
Sidebar — app navigation with many destinations or nested sections (Default, With alert, Double; collapsible).
Sidebar item — icon + label link with optional badge (Initial, Hover/Active, Disabled, Collapsed group).
Sidebar header — logo, heading or user select.
Interactive spinner — animation frames for prototypes.
Spinner — indeterminate loading indicator (xs 12, sm 24, md 50, lg 75, xl 100; optional track).
Speed dial — floating action button revealing 3–6 creation actions (vertical, horizontal, menu).
Speed dial item — action button with icon/label (Initial, Hover, Disabled; square or round).
Speed dial menus — vertical, horizontal, or dropdown list of actions.
Interactive speed dial — prototype flow.
Interactive speed dial — prototype flow.
Skeleton — loading placeholder matching the final layout (card, image + text, text, list, widget).
Stepper examples — stepper inside a card with step content and actions.
Stepper — progress through a linear multi-step process (default, icons, dots, vertical, cards).
Stepper step — 7 types × Initial/Active/Completed/Error/Disabled.
Table — structured data to compare, sort or act on (striped rows/columns, caption, toolbar, status badges, row actions).
Timeline dot — ellipse, icon or avatar marker.
Timeline — chronological events or activity (vertical, cards, user actions, stacked, horizontal).
Timeline item — event content (text & button, card, user actions, stacked cards, horizontal).
KBD — keyboard key for shortcuts in tooltips, menus and docs.
Tooltip — short (≤8 words) label on hover and focus (top, bottom, left, right).
Toast — brief, non-blocking feedback about an action just taken (auto-dismiss 4–6s).
Avatar — person or organisation picture or initials (6 sizes; status dot; remove button; placeholder).
Avatar group — overlapping avatars with an optional counter.
Avatar label — name and helper text next to an avatar.
Avatar status dot — online, offline, away.
Avatar remove button.
Table header — toolbar above the table: search, filters, actions, tabs or stats (13 types × Desktop/Tablet/Mobile). Maps to the `toolbar` prop.
Table header cell — column heading (Text, Checkbox & icon, Only icon). Maps to <TableHeaderCell>.
Table cell — body cell content (text, badge, buttons, avatar, progress, form controls…) × Initial/Hover. Maps to <TableCell>.
Table footer — row below the table: pagination, page-size select, counters and CTAs. Compose <Pagination> below the Table.
Skeleton text block — placeholder lines (Small/Medium/Large × tone, light/dark). Maps to <SkeletonLine>.
Separator — divider with centered text (Default, Gradient lines, Dashed), e.g. "or" between sign-in options.
Country flag — rounded flag artwork (12 countries × base/sm) for language and region pickers.
